text: {"lessons":["Selling winners because they are up can leave me buying them back later at much higher prices; I should trade only when the investment case or portfolio plan changes.","Doing nothing through a sustained decline is not automatically patience; I should review risks and position sizes at set intervals, even if I rarely check my account.","Before buying, I should decide how much of my portfolio I want exposed to each stock and keep enough cash to avoid making rushed, all-or-nothing decisions."]}
